title: "Not Everyone Who Says ‘Lord, Lord’ Will Enter Heaven" 🔥
paragraphs: "Not Everyone Who Says ‘Lord, Lord’ Will Enter Heaven" 🔥

🔥 IMAGINE STANDING BEFORE JESUS… THINKING YOU’RE SAVED… BUT HE LOOKS AT YOU AND SAYS:
🚪 "DEPART FROM ME—I NEVER KNEW YOU."

💀 This is the reality for MANY who call themselves Christians today.
❌ They went to church.
❌ They knew Bible verses.
❌ They called Jesus ‘Lord’… but they NEVER truly followed Him.
🚨 Just because you call yourself a Christian DOES NOT mean you are saved.
📖 "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven." (Matthew 7:21)
😨 The scariest thing on Judgment Day? THINKING YOU WERE SAVED WHEN YOU WEREN’T.

🔥 1. FAKE CHRISTIANS WILL BE EXPOSED ON JUDGMENT DAY
📖 "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and cast out demons in Your name?’ Then I will declare to them, ‘I NEVER KNEW YOU; depart from Me.’" (Matthew 7:22-23)

💀 MANY will be SHOCKED when they hear these words.
🚨 They thought they were Christians, but Jesus NEVER knew them.

🔥 YOU CAN GO TO CHURCH AND STILL GO TO HELL.
🔥 YOU CAN CALL JESUS "LORD" AND STILL BE LOST.
⚠️ The question isn’t "Do you know Jesus?"—the question is, "Does Jesus know YOU?"

🔥 2. SIGNS THAT YOU MIGHT BE A FAKE CHRISTIAN
📖 "Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith." (2 Corinthians 13:5)
🚨 Here are 5 warning signs that someone is NOT truly saved:

1️⃣ You believe in Jesus, but you don’t OBEY Him.
📖 "If you love Me, you will keep My commandments." (John 14:15)

2️⃣ You go to church, but your heart is far from God.
📖 "This people honors Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me." (Matthew 15:8)

3️⃣ You still love the world more than you love Jesus.
📖 "Do not love the world or the things in the world." (1 John 2:15)

4️⃣ You only turn to God when you need something.
📖 "Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness." (Matthew 6:33)

5️⃣ You have never truly repented—you just want to "feel good" about Jesus.
📖 "Unless you repent, you will all likewise perish." (Luke 13:3)
🔥 Which of these warning signs apply to you?
🚨 Today is the day to get REAL with God before it’s too late!

🔥 3. HOW TO MAKE SURE YOU ARE TRULY SAVED
📖 "The one who endures to the end will be saved." (Matthew 24:13)
🚀 Here’s how to make sure you are NOT a fake Christian:

✅ 1. SURRENDER TO JESUS COMPLETELY – Give Him TOTAL control of your life.
📖 "Deny yourself, take up your cross daily, and follow Me." (Luke 9:23)

✅ 2. REPENT AND TURN FROM SIN – Stop making excuses and truly change.
📖 "Repent and turn back, that your sins may be wiped away." (Acts 3:19)

✅ 3. SEEK GOD DAILY – Not just when you need something.
📖 "Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you." (James 4:8)

✅ 4. BE FILLED WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT – You can’t do it on your own.
📖 "Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh." (Galatians 5:16)
🔥 STOP PLAYING CHURCH AND START FOLLOWING JESUS!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if you refuse to be deceived!

🔥 THE TRUE SALVATION CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly following Jesus or just claiming to?
✅ Step 2: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this truth before it’s too late!
🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 22, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, I don’t want to just call You "Lord" with my lips—I want to truly follow You with my life. Lord, if I have been living a fake Christian life, convict me and change me. I surrender completely to You. Wash me clean, fill me with Your Spirit, and help me to walk in true obedience. I don’t want to hear "Depart from Me"—I want to hear "Well done, good and faithful servant." In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
